subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be closed by a larger fixed initial Control UI history window, or should closure require a load-older pagination affordance that requests older `chat.history` offset pages?
rationale: Current source confirms the 100-message cap and an offset-capable backend, while docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for browser stability; the correct UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older bounded pages on demand while preserving the fast initial render window.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Treat a coordinated fixed-limit increase as sufficient only if render behavior, tests, and browser proof show users can reach the extra messages.

options.title: Defer to broader pagination PR
options.body: Use the broader WebChat/Gateway pagination PR as the fix path only after its conflicts, proof, and maintainer-review blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older bounded pages on demand while preserving the fast initial render window.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI history cap, render cap, and gateway offset behavior points to Vincent Koc commits.
